thousNpc1PinkHorror.threat: Splits into Blue Horrors when it dies, so every kill adds bodies to the board, and its ranged Psychic attack ignores armour.
thousNpc1PinkHorror.counter: Overkill it so the split does less, and keep area damage ready for the Blue Horrors.

blackNpc1Bloodletter.threat: A glass cannon: fast Daemon melee with Piercing damage that cuts through armoured frontliners.
blackNpc1Bloodletter.counter: Kill it first, before it reaches your line; it falls quickly to focused fire.

thousNpc2Screamer.threat: Flying, and its Slashing Dive hits every unit along its path.
thousNpc2Screamer.counter: Don't line your characters up; spread out so a dive hits one of them.

deathNpc3Nurglings.threat: Mischief Makers stops healing on the units next to it for a round, which breaks healer corners; it also teleports in and explodes.
deathNpc3Nurglings.counter: Kill it from range before it reaches your healer.

thousNpc3RubricMarine.threat: Tanky, with a ranged Flame attack; All is Dust makes it hard to wear down.
thousNpc3RubricMarine.counter: Bring armour-piercing damage and don't trade with it at range.

worldNpc1Berzerker.threat: Rapid Assault and Blood Surge: it moves when attacked and hits hard in melee.
worldNpc1Berzerker.counter: Kill it in one turn or keep out of its reach; chip damage triggers it.

eldarNpc1Guardian.threat: Ranged grunt that comes in numbers; Plasma Grenade adds burst.
eldarNpc1Guardian.counter: Area damage; Battle Fatigue makes them flee when their neighbours die.

eldarNpc2Warlock.threat: Psyker that raises the damage of the enemies around it.
eldarNpc2Warlock.counter: Kill it early to take the buff off the rest of the wave.

eldarNpc3Harlequin.threat: High mobility, Infiltrate and four Power hits that also hit adjacent allies; Unstoppable.
eldarNpc3Harlequin.counter: Don't turtle in a tight corner: spread out and focus it before it reaches your squishy units.

eldarNpc4Wraithguard.threat: Large Energy attacks, Overwatch and Big Target bulk.
eldarNpc4Wraithguard.counter: Don't walk into its Overwatch range; spread out and break it with armour-piercing damage.

darkaNpc1Infiltrator.threat: Ranged grunt with Overwatch that comes in numbers.
darkaNpc1Infiltrator.counter: Low priority; clear with area damage.

bloodNpc1Intercessor.threat: Deep-strikes into your line and keeps up melee pressure; flying.
bloodNpc1Intercessor.counter: Leave a guard on your backline and kill it as it lands.

darkaNpc2Hellblaster.threat: Heavy Weapon plasma from range 3 that one-shots squishy units; it sits back while others close in.
darkaNpc2Hellblaster.counter: Rush it or out-range it; don't let a wave of them fire freely.

darkaNpc3Terminator.threat: Deep-strikes in Terminator armour and soaks low-pierce hits.
darkaNpc3Terminator.counter: Bring high-pierce damage and don't waste low-damage hits on it.

admecNpc1Vanguard.threat: Toxic ranged fire, and Rad-Saturation leaves Contamination on each hex it moves through or stands on.
admecNpc1Vanguard.counter: Kill it early, before Contamination spreads across your approach, and don't stand on its hexes.

admecNpc2Techpriest.threat: Repairs the Mechanical units around it, and every adjacent Mechanical death gives it Machine Vengeance that it hands to the unit it repairs.
admecNpc2Techpriest.counter: Kill it first in a Mechanicus wave; killing its escorts first only stacks Machine Vengeance on the survivors.

admecNpc3Electropriest.threat: Resilient melee whose Electro-Shock splashes Particle damage onto a second adjacent unit and Suppresses both; heals make it hit harder.
admecNpc3Electropriest.counter: Don't stand two characters next to each other in front of it, and don't heal it with splash heals.

astraNpc1Guardsman.threat: Cheap Las infantry that comes in numbers and chips at range.
astraNpc1Guardsman.counter: Area damage clears them; Battle Fatigue makes them weaker as their neighbours die.

astraNpc4Mortar.threat: Indirect Blast fire at range 5 that hits the target and random adjacent hexes, Suppressing everything it hits, even behind cover.
astraNpc4Mortar.counter: Close the distance fast; it is weak in melee and its Two-Man Team cap doesn't stop Blast damage.

blackNpc2Terminator.threat: Deep Strikes onto the board, hits hard in melee and at range, and Draw Fire soaks half the hits aimed at its neighbours; Terminator Armour cuts the first attack each turn.
blackNpc2Terminator.counter: Open on it with a weak attack to strip the armour reduction, then hit hard; use Psychic or Direct damage where you can.

blackNpc3TraitorGuardsman.threat: Las infantry whose Crazed Focus deals extra damage to units standing on any hex effect, such as Despoiled Ground from Let the Galaxy Burn.
blackNpc3TraitorGuardsman.counter: Move off hex effects before they shoot, and clear them with area damage.

blackNpc4Havoc.threat: Eight ranged hits with Suppressive Fire and Overwatch; Firing Position keeps it in Overwatch after each kill.
blackNpc4Havoc.counter: Don't walk into its Overwatch: use Infiltrate units, deep strikers or long range to remove it first.

deathNpc1Poxwalker.threat: Slow and weak alone, but each non-Mechanical character it kills becomes another Poxwalker, and its Nurgle aura lowers your armour.
deathNpc1Poxwalker.counter: Keep it off low-health characters and kill the pack with area damage before the aura grows.

deathNpc2PlagueMarine.threat: Resilient, throws Blight Grenades through up to three units in a line, and takes 30% less damage on Contaminated hexes; its aura lowers your armour.
deathNpc2PlagueMarine.counter: Attack it off Contamination, and don't line your characters up behind each other.

deathNpc4BlightlordTerminator.threat: Terminator Armour with a growing armour-shredding aura; each kill carries over the leftover damage plus Toxic hits to a nearby character.
deathNpc4BlightlordTerminator.counter: Focus it early with Psychic or Direct damage and keep wounded characters away from it.

necroNpc1Warrior.threat: Living Metal regenerates every turn, and Reanimation Protocols gives a 35% chance to stand back up while another Warrior lives.
necroNpc1Warrior.counter: Kill the whole squad in the same turn; chip damage and spread fire are wasted.

necroNpc2FlayedOne.threat: Terrifying melee that attacks twice in a row if it starts its turn next to you, and reanimates like Warriors.
necroNpc2FlayedOne.counter: Never end a turn adjacent to it; kill it at range or in one turn.

necroNpc3Deathmark.threat: Spends a turn aiming, then fires one huge Energy shot at its target.
necroNpc3Deathmark.counter: Kill it, or move out of its line, during the turn it takes aim.

necroNpc4Destroyer.threat: Tunnels under the board, pops up next to your back line and attacks at once; takes reduced melee damage.
necroNpc4Destroyer.counter: Keep your fragile characters clustered with a tank, and answer it with ranged damage.

necroNpc5Swarm.threat: Fast flying swarm with five Energy hits that can summon another Swarm, which acts immediately.
necroNpc5Swarm.counter: Kill it quickly with area or multi-hit attacks before the copies stack up.

orksNpc1Grot.threat: Tiny and weak, but Diminutive takes one hit off every multi-hit attack, and a Grot at full health can summon more Grots.
orksNpc1Grot.counter: Damage every Grot each turn so none ends at full health, and use single big hits rather than many small ones.

orksNpc2OrkBoy.threat: Ork melee and shooting backed by a Stikkbomb that also hits the hexes around its target.
orksNpc2OrkBoy.counter: Spread out to dodge the bomb splash and use area damage on the mob.

orksNpc3GrotTank.threat: Mechanical vehicle with Blast fire at range 3; Ramshackle cuts damage from low-pierce attacks.
orksNpc3GrotTank.counter: Use high-pierce damage; Physical and other low-pierce attacks lose most of their damage.

orksNpc6Stormboy.threat: Flies straight into any hex on turn one and moves fast; it may blow itself up after a long move.
orksNpc6Stormboy.counter: Guard your back line, and don't waste big attacks on a Stormboy that may explode on its own.

orksNpc7Squig.threat: Hard-hitting melee that can bounce away when hit and damage whoever it lands next to.
orksNpc7Squig.counter: Kill it in one big hit, or expect it to land on another of your characters.

tauNpc1FireWarrior.threat: Range 3 Pulse fire that hits harder when nobody is next to it, with Overwatch and Suppressive Fire.
tauNpc1FireWarrior.counter: Get adjacent to switch off Ranged Specialist; avoid walking into its Overwatch with key characters.

tauNpc2DroneSniper.threat: Flying range 4 Piercing sniper that takes hits meant for nearby T'au.
tauNpc2DroneSniper.counter: Kill the drones before the T'au they protect, or your damage goes into the drones.

tauNpc3DroneShield.threat: Absorbs half of the hits aimed at nearby T'au units.
tauNpc3DroneShield.counter: Kill the Shield Drone first; otherwise your burst on key T'au targets gets soaked.

tauNpc5StealthSuit.threat: Camouflaged and Infiltrating; it Markerlights a target and then teleports to shoot it, taking half damage from ranged attacks while that lasts.
tauNpc5StealthSuit.counter: Hit it in melee or with abilities, and kill it before it teleports behind your line.

tauNpc6Carnivore.threat: Camouflaged melee ambusher with Rapid Assault; it gets more damage and toughness in Tall Grass.
tauNpc6Carnivore.counter: Keep it out of Tall Grass and use melee; its Camouflage cuts ranged hits against it.

templNpc1Initiate.threat: Chain melee with an extra Heavy Bolt Pistol hit; its push attack lets it move in and step deeper.
templNpc1Initiate.counter: Stop it at your front line with a tank before it reaches your shooters.

templNpc2Neophyte.threat: Its Incendiary Shells deal Flame damage at range.
templNpc2Neophyte.counter: Low priority unless your team is weak to Flame; clean it up with area damage.

templNpc3InitiatePyreblaster.threat: Its Flame attack also sets the hex behind the target on Fire, so two characters standing in a line both burn.
templNpc3InitiatePyreblaster.counter: Don't line up behind your front liner, and keep fragile characters away from burning hexes.

templNpc4Aggressor.threat: Gravis armour makes every hit go through armour twice; Fragstorm splashes Blast damage and its fire Suppresses.
templNpc4Aggressor.counter: Use high-pierce damage, crits or Psychic damage; low-damage multi-hit attacks bounce off.
